handler.dashboard|en|statistics_cpi:
**CPI (Consumer Price Index)** measures average price changes for a basket of goods and services bought by households.

In India:
• **CPI-Combined**: Released monthly by MoSPI/NSO (base year 2012)
• **Laspeyres formula** (fixed base-period weights)
• Covers **299 items** across 6 groups: Food, Fuel, Housing, Clothing, Miscellaneous
• Used by RBI as the **inflation targeting benchmark** (target: 4% ± 2%)
handler.dashboard|en|statistics_frac:
**FRAC (Framework for Roles, Activities and Competencies)** is the Government of India's competency architecture for civil servants on iGOT Karmayogi.

FRAC defines:
• **Roles**: Job positions (Deputy Director, Field Investigator, etc.)
• **Activities**: Key functions performed in a role
• **Competencies**: Skills grouped as Behavioural (B), Domain (D), Functional (F)

Your skill gap assessment here is **fully aligned with the FRAC dictionary**. 📋
handler.dashboard|en|statistics_gdp:
**GDP (Gross Domestic Product)** in India is compiled by the National Statistical Office (NSO) following the **System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA 2008)**.

Three approaches:
• **Expenditure method**: C + I + G + (X−M)
• **Production method**: Sum of GVA across industries + taxes − subsidies
• **Income method**: Compensation of employees + gross operating surplus

India releases GDP quarterly, with two advance estimates. Base year: **2011-12**.

Key agency: NSO under MoSPI. 🇮🇳
handler.dashboard|en|statistics_sampling:
**Sampling in official statistics** — selecting a subset to estimate population parameters.

Key types used in NSSO surveys:
• **Stratified Sampling**: Population divided into strata (urban/rural, states)
• **Cluster Sampling**: Groups (villages/blocks) selected first
• **Multi-stage Sampling**: Used in PLFS, HCES — districts → blocks → households

NSSO uses a **rotating panel design** for many surveys to track changes over time.

handler.home|en|statistics_cpi:
**CPI (Consumer Price Index)** measures average price changes for a basket of goods and services bought by households.

In India:
• **CPI-Combined**: Released monthly by MoSPI/NSO (base year 2012)
• **Laspeyres formula** (fixed base-period weights)
• Covers **299 items** across 6 groups: Food, Fuel, Housing, Clothing, Miscellaneous
• Used by RBI as the **inflation targeting benchmark** (target: 4% ± 2%)
handler.home|en|statistics_frac:
**FRAC (Framework for Roles, Activities and Competencies)** is the Government of India's competency architecture for civil servants on iGOT Karmayogi.

FRAC defines:
• **Roles**: Job positions (Deputy Director, Field Investigator, etc.)
• **Activities**: Key functions performed in a role
• **Competencies**: Skills grouped as Behavioural (B), Domain (D), Functional (F)

Your skill gap assessment here is **fully aligned with the FRAC dictionary**. 📋
handler.home|en|statistics_gdp:
**GDP (Gross Domestic Product)** in India is compiled by the National Statistical Office (NSO) following the **System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA 2008)**.

Three approaches:
• **Expenditure method**: C + I + G + (X−M)
• **Production method**: Sum of GVA across industries + taxes − subsidies
• **Income method**: Compensation of employees + gross operating surplus

India releases GDP quarterly, with two advance estimates. Base year: **2011-12**.

Key agency: NSO under MoSPI. 🇮🇳
handler.home|en|statistics_sampling:
**Sampling in official statistics** — selecting a subset to estimate population parameters.

Key types used in NSSO surveys:
• **Stratified Sampling**: Population divided into strata (urban/rural, states)
• **Cluster Sampling**: Groups (villages/blocks) selected first
• **Multi-stage Sampling**: Used in PLFS, HCES — districts → blocks → households

NSSO uses a **rotating panel design** for many surveys to track changes over time.
